purpose: Post-hoc mechanism diagnosis, not retuning or replacement of the original benchmark

interventions.behavior_labels: Relabel integrity-only training episodes as behavior-normal; raw telemetry and all test labels remain unchanged
interventions.sequence_exposure: Replace one of two fanout episodes per training run with a sequence episode; number of positive labels unchanged
interventions.deeper: Original training labels and data, max_depth 6 and 300 boosting iterations instead of depth 3 and 100 iterations

external_diagnostics: Check whether new_pair is constant in the normal fit data and whether IsolationForest ever splits on it
Measure attacks on new versus previously seen directed IP pairs
Measure overlap of static packet signatures with normal packets
Measure score saturation when only a constant fit feature is changed
interpretation: Exposure to sequence attacks is an explanatory intervention; its performance is not zero-day detection. No positive effect is required for CI success. Original protocol and experiment source files must remain byte-identical.
